title: The password
starting_code: # Say the password, then walk through the gate.
hints: You need to make your wizard speak, and then move.
The password must be exactly as written, inside quotes.
First use the `say` method to speak the string, then walk up.
intro: An older pupil told me the password for this gate! It is *ambrel*. Say it, and walk through to the corner up the path.
outro: The gate opened! Words have real power here. Let us keep going up the path.
learned: Now you know what a string is, and how to use it to make your wizard say things.
